title: Argentinian Beef Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with thinly sliced beef and Chinese stir-fry sauce. Serve over rice or noodles for a delicious and easy meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced ginger and garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced snow peas and bell peppers to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Return the cooked beef to the skillet and pour in the Chinese stir-fry sauce. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
